stories.title: Greater Eurasian Partnership to help remove trade, investment barriers — Lavrov
stories.summary: Russian Foreign Minister noted that the current stage of global development, marked by the strengthening of multipolar principles in international affairs, offers broad opportunities to create new and fairer mechanisms for global economic cooperation.
article_sentences: The formation of the Greater Eurasian Partnership will help remove barriers to trade and investment and establish more advanced economic ties across Eurasia, according to a message from Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov to participants in the Dialogue of Young Diplomats from Greater Eurasian Partnership countries in Kazan.

The minister noted that the current stage of global development, marked by the strengthening of multipolar principles in international affairs, offers broad opportunities to create new and fairer mechanisms for global economic cooperation.

"Russian President Vladimir Putin’s initiative to form the Greater Eurasian Partnership is designed to consolidate integration processes on the continent, help remove barriers to trade and investment, and establish more advanced, balanced and reliable economic ties across the vast expanse of Eurasia," he said.

stories.title: Niger authorities say military mutiny in Niamey suppressed
stories.summary: The authorities urged residents to remain calm and continue with their daily activities.
article_sentences: Niger’s defense and security forces have suppressed a mutiny by a group of military personnel in the capital, Niamey, and are gradually restoring control over strategic sites in the city, the Niger Press Agency reported, citing a Defense Ministry statement read on state television.
According to the ministry, the mutiny began at around 12:20 a.m. local time.

A group of military personnel who had breached military discipline attempted to detain some of their fellow servicemen at Air Base 101 in Niamey and opened fire on several strategic sites in the city.
"The swift response by the defense and security forces made it possible to contain this mutiny and gradually restore control over these sites," the statement said.
The authorities urged residents to remain calm and continue with their daily activities.
Gunfire and explosions were heard overnight in several areas of Niamey.

The most intense exchanges of fire occurred near Air Base 101, located next to Diori Hamani International Airport, which also hosts Russian military personnel from the Russian Defense Ministry’s Africa Corps.
